title: An integer multiplicity 2-cycle supported in finitely many 2-planes meeting at 0 has integer density at 0
statement: Let P, q ∈ ℕ, let C ∈ 𝒟_2(ℝ^P) be integer multiplicity with ∂C = 0 (BoundaryVanishes C), and let P_1, …, P_q (a family indexed by Fin q) be 2-dimensional linear subspaces of ℝ^P with P_i ∩ P_j = {0} (P_i ⊓ P_j = ⊥) for i ≠ j, such that every x ∈ spt C with x ≠ 0 lies in some P_i. Then there is m ∈ ℕ with HasMassDensity C 0 m, i.e. Θ²(μ_C, 0) = m.
lean_statement: ∀ (P q : ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 2) (Ps : Fin q → Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), IsIntegerMultiplicity C → BoundaryVanishes C → (∀ i, Module.finrank ℝ (Ps i) = 2) → (∀ i j, i ≠ j → Ps i ⊓ Ps j = ⊥) → (∀ x ∈ C.support, x ≠ 0 → ∃ i, x ∈ Ps i) → ∃ m : ℕ, HasMassDensity C 0 m
